Doctor: What medicines are you taking at the moment?
Patient: I used to take amlodipine, but I stopped it. Now I take ramipril 5 mg once a day.
Doctor: And for your knees?
Patient: Both knees ache, so I take paracetamol when I need it.
Doctor: Any allergies?
Patient: My sister is allergic to latex. I'm not allergic to anything.
